meta.name: dy1.mag editorial carousel format
meta.description: 1080x1350 Instagram carousel format extracted from dy1.mag reference: documentary image, white editorial whitespace, bold Korean sans-serif typography, underlined thesis line, minimal black progress marker.

primary.role: dominant text, borders, page marker, black CTA slide

secondary.role: main body slide background and large negative space

accent.role: rare CTA highlight on black slide

neutral.usage: white and warm-white dominate; black is reserved for type, borders, and CTA background; warm grays come from documentary photo treatment

color.contrast_strategy: dark-on-light dominant with one full black CTA slide; emphasis comes from weight and underline rather than colored panels

font_families.heading: Pretendard, SUIT, Noto Sans KR, Apple SD Gothic Neo, sans-serif
font_families.body: Pretendard, SUIT, Noto Sans KR, Apple SD Gothic Neo, sans-serif

typography.font_style_notes: clean Korean grotesk sans; no decorative type; hierarchy is created through weight, size, and underline

spacing.section_rhythm: large top image block followed by generous text whitespace; each slide intentionally has one focal idea

layout.grid_system: single centered column with occasional two-image inset composition
layout.columns: 1 primary column; 2 columns only for comparison/product frames

shape.border_usage: sharp 2-3px black borders around image frames and small progress marker
shape.divider_style: underline on emphasized copy; no decorative dividers except black bottom marker

levels.high: cover uses dark gradient overlay instead of shadow

elevation.depth_cues: photo cropping, black borders, image inset overlay, full-bleed cover gradient

iconography.size_scale: logos small and factual, not decorative
iconography.preferred_set: avoid icons unless needed for source or partner marks

components.button_style: no buttons; CTA appears as text or URL
components.card_style: avoid decorative cards; use bare image frames and text blocks
components.navigation_pattern: small black bottom-right marker implies carousel progress
components.list_style: short paragraph blocks; avoid bullet-heavy slides
components.component_notes: primary components are cover image, framed image, source caption, center body copy, underlined thesis, black CTA slide

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: startup magazine case-study spread translated into Instagram cards
aesthetic.era_influence: modern Korean business media, founder interview editorial, clean social newsroom

visual_language.whitespace_usage: very generous; whitespace carries credibility and pacing
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: top-heavy image or cover photo, then centered text block; CTA slide inverts to black
visual_language.focal_strategy: single dominant image or single underlined thesis per slide
visual_language.contrast_level: high contrast black text on white; white text on black for CTA
visual_language.texture_usage: documentary photo grain and cover photo texture only

composition.hierarchy_method: scale contrast, weight contrast, spatial isolation, underline emphasis
composition.balance_type: mostly symmetric with occasional inset image asymmetry
composition.flow_direction: top image to lower text, then emphasized thesis line
composition.grouping_strategy: image, source, body paragraph, thesis are separated by whitespace

imagery.photo_treatment: real documentary photos and interview/video stills; natural color, slight warmth, no heavy filters except cover dark gradient
imagery.graphic_elements: thin black borders, underline, tiny bottom marker, occasional inset frame
imagery.pattern_usage: cover may include large cropped brand/logotype texture; body pages stay plain
imagery.image_shape: rectangular, sharp corners, full-bleed cover or framed body image

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: short direct invitation, usually URL or recruiting line

background_effects.description: white or black solid surfaces; cover uses source photo/brand background

text_effects.description: static typographic emphasis through bold weight and underline

image_effects.description: body images are sharp framed; cover uses full-bleed image with dark lower gradient for white title readability

visual_effects.composite_notes: This format should remain static. The most important effects are not animation but editorial restraint: large whitespace, documentary image evidence, a single underlined thesis, and almost no decorative UI.
